audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer frames the lane as HARD 8/10 with every phase Lissandra, while the content layer, the packet level chart and the 49.9% win rate over 1465 games all say Qiyana controls every stage. The two halves of the page argue with each other.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is all-Qiyana and content win[]/whys[] give kit-grounded reasons (no early kill threat, 24s Glacial Path, point-blank W ring).
audit.corrected: Level chart sides aligned to Qiyana with grounded whys. The diff/tone/diffRating verdict itself was left for the user to decide (see notes/questions).

audit.why: Spikes are sound: 3-5 out-trade on her cooldowns, 6 burst vs Tomb self-cast, first item kill-before-Tomb, late pick threat vs her teamfight R. All 4 entries present.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits; the missing interactions (Frozen Tomb self-cast goes untargetable through your commit; her R self-heal wants Grievous Wounds) were absent from the full layer.
audit.why: Glacial Path 24/21/18/15/12s, Ring of Frost 10s at rank 1, Frozen Tomb 120/100/80s with heal+untargetable flags in the kit.
audit.corrected: Numbers and both interactions written into breakdown.cooldowns and phases[4].why.

notes: Full-layer chart had all seven sides on Lissandra while every why described Qiyana winning — the exact side/why self-contradiction the run guards against. Packet chart and content win[] both say Qiyana on all seven rows, so sides were aligned to them with grounded whys (win[N] already correct, no content pairs needed). The page-level verdict (diff HARD 8/10, tone #ff5d6c, carry 8.5/10, tldr calling her 'the anti-Qiyana pick', breakdown.difficulty, report[14]) still contradicts a 49.9% WR and an all-Qiyana chart, but changing it required a judgement call plus a third report-entry edit, so it was left alone and raised as a question. All 11 lint findings addressed. Missing interactions (Tomb untargetability, anti-heal need) folded into phases[4].why and breakdown.cooldowns.
